original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚高原州潘克辛地方政府主席誓言打击疑似仪式杀人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚高原州潘克辛地方政府委员会主席费利克斯·戈农表示，将打击当地疑似仪式杀人行为。他称一个月内当地记录到两起死亡事件，受害者据称被摘取重要器官，上月发现一名女性遗体后已有三名嫌疑人被捕，另有一名年轻男子遗体于10月6日在Monday Market被发现。相关事件可能与学生中的邪教活动或犯罪分子有关，目前由安全机构调查中。

location.raw_text: Pankshin Local Government Council of Plateau

key_facts.fact: 潘克辛地方政府主席誓言打击当地疑似仪式杀人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Council chairman vows to crackdown on suspected ritual killings in Pangshin

key_facts.fact: 一个月内当地记录到两起死亡事件，受害者据称被摘取重要器官
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: has vowed to crack down on suspected ritual killings after two deaths were recorded in the area within a month. Gonung... confirmed that vital organs were allegedly harvested from the victims.

key_facts.fact: 上月发现一名女性遗体后有三名嫌疑人被捕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said three suspects were arrested following the discovery of a woman’s body last month.

key_facts.fact: 10月6日在Monday Market发现一名年轻男子遗体，据称重要器官缺失
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: security agencies were also investigating the discovery of a young man’s body at Monday Market on Oct. 6, with vital organs allegedly missing.

key_facts.fact: 事件可能与学生中的邪教活动或犯罪分子有关
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said the incident might be linked to cult activities among students or criminal elements operating within the student community

uncertainties: 两起死亡是否确为仪式杀人尚未证实，官方表述为疑似（suspected）
受害者重要器官被摘取的说法为据称（allegedly），尚未获确认
年轻男子遗体事件与学生邪教或犯罪分子的关联仅为可能（might be linked），有待核实
目前仅单一来源（尼日利亚通讯社NAN）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
